mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months signals rising inflation expectations, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in improving labor market conditions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months signals rising economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Retail Sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals rising consumer spending and housing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 2% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rising consumer spending and housing activity are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) and increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines > 0.5% and PAYEMS increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in improving labor market conditions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% decline in GDP (GDPC1) over the past 6 months signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
